title: Recover living Report finalization after credential expiry

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Dogfood reproduction: a read-only portfolio run completed its zero-cost workflow but temporary production API credentials expired during finalization. Required Report and Task writes failed closed, leaving the durable stakeholder state behind the in-memory procedure result. Renewing credentials allowed the same Task and Report IDs to be reused, but the current retry path republished an empty started revision and repeated analysis. Next: preserve the latest durable milestone on retry and add a credential-lifetime/recovery contract before implementation.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Read-only investigation: local Cognito GraphQL transport obtains a bearer token once during client construction and freezes it in static headers; its token provider already supports refresh, so requests made after access-token expiry cannot recover. The portfolio runner creates a new empty in-memory state on every invocation and unconditionally publishes the started milestone after start_or_resume; the durable latest immutable evidence exists but is not read back, so retry recomputes earlier stages. Proposed minimal repair: request-time Cognito auth plus verified latest-evidence hydration through existing TASK_ATTACHMENT ticket reads, with runner progression keyed by the last durable milestone. Preserve the same outer procedure Task/Report; fail closed if the latest evidence cannot be verified.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Implemented the isolated Cognito request-time refresh slice without touching procedure/report code. Test-first evidence: the new prepared-request contract initially failed against static Authorization headers (3 focused failures), then passed after adding a small AuthBase adapter. ...............................                                          [100%]
31 passed in 4.87s => 31 passed. The test proves one client receives token A then token B on two requests and a later refresh failure raises without API-key fallback. Uncommitted; only plexus/dashboard/api/client.py and plexus/dashboard/api/client_test.py changed.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the outside-in recovery repair locally. Request-time Cognito authentication now obtains the current token for every outbound request and fails closed without API-key fallback. Living Reports now load the latest committed evidence through the authorized Task-attachment route, verify integrity and frozen identity, resume from the last durable milestone, avoid repeating completed analysis/dispatch/review work, and use unique artifact keys for interrupted publication retries. Focused validation: 96 tests passed across API client, Report lifecycle, and portfolio runner; diff check passed. Next: inspect the combined diff, run a read-only recovery acceptance, and keep this bug open until the fixes land.
